scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:format
scripts.e2e: bun e2e/threads.ts && bun e2e/github.ts && bun e2e/watchdog.ts && bun e2e/install.ts && bun e2e/repos.ts && bun e2e/colors.ts && bun e2e/long-text.ts
scripts.prepare: bun -e "if (!Bun.semver.satisfies(Bun.version, '>=1.4.4')) { console.error('Bun >=1.4.4 required, found ' + Bun.version); process.exit(1) }"
